characters.continuity: Mortal Kombat series (Modern Era / NRS timeline)
characters.summary: Liu Kang is a master martial artist and former Shaolin monk who fights using hand-to-hand combat combined with mystical projectile fireballs and bicycle kicks. He relies on speed, discipline, and powerful physical striking to overwhelm opponents.

mechanisms: Durability scaling to superhuman martial artists

weaknesses: Vulnerable to surprise attacks when distracted
Subject to standard human mortal limitations prior to godhood
limitations: Relies primarily on physical conditioning and martial arts training.

sources.supports: General character background, abilities, and status in Mortal Kombat.

feats.claim: Defeated Shang Tsung in martial arts combat during the Mortal Kombat tournament.

unknowns: Exact limits of his mortal stamina before augmentation.

characters.summary: Having merged with Raiden and ascended to divinity, Fire God Liu Kang commands immense elemental power over fire and lightning, shaping time and reality while fighting with divine martial arts and a celestial weapon.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to powerful temporal manipulation or divine-tier magic equal to his own
limitations: Bound by duties as protector of time and keeper of the hourglass.
characters.formDifferences: Changes Liu Kang from a mortal martial artist into a divine entity possessing combined fire and lightning manipulation, flight, and reality-shaping capabilities.

sources.supports: Fire God Liu Kang ascension and status as a deity in Mortal Kombat 11.

notableResults.note: Fought as Fire God Liu Kang after merging with Raiden.

campaignTags.claim: Wields divine fire powers as a Fire God.
Controls divine flame to incinerate foes.
Inherited lightning powers from Raiden upon ascension.
Commands lightning alongside fire in combat.
Floats and flies naturally using divine power.

unknowns: Full extent of his control over the new timeline.

characters.summary: Luigi is Mario's taller brother who fights using high vertical jumps, unpredictable momentum slides, and occasional ghost-hunting equipment. Though timid, he possesses hidden athletic prowess that rivals Mario's.
weaknesses: Prone to cowardice and panic in scary situations
limitations: Traction issues cause him to slide when stopping.

sources.supports: Luigi's characteristics, jumping abilities, and appearances in the Mario franchise.

feats.claim: Rescued Mario and cleared haunted mansions single-handedly using the Poltergust.

campaignTags.claim: Uses the Poltergust series of ghost-capturing vacuums.

unknowns: The absolute upper limit of his hidden potential when frightened.

characters.summary: Ice Luigi is a powered-up form of Luigi that allows him to hurl freezing projectiles that encase enemies in blocks of ice.

mechanisms: Freezing enemies before they can attack

weaknesses: Power-up is lost upon taking damage from an enemy
limitations: Ice projectiles travel in a bouncing arc with limited range.
characters.formDifferences: Grants Luigi the ability to throw ice balls and slide on icy surfaces with modified traction, replacing his standard form until damage is taken.

sources.supports: Details on the Ice Flower power-up and Ice Luigi capabilities.

campaignTags.claim: Can project ice balls to freeze enemies.
Manipulates ice energy to create projectile attacks.

unknowns: Duration of the ice flower transformation without taking damage.

characters.summary: Super Star Luigi is an invulnerable, glowing state that grants high-speed movement and instant defeat of any enemy touched.

mechanisms: Complete invulnerability to all standard attacks and hazards

weaknesses: Does not protect against falling into bottomless pits
limitations: Wears off rapidly after a brief musical theme plays.
characters.formDifferences: Grants temporary invulnerability and higher movement speed, causing enemies to be defeated instantly upon contact.

sources.supports: Super Star mechanics and invulnerability effects across the Mario series.

unknowns: Exact duration in seconds across different game engines.

characters.summary: M. Bison is the ruthless dictator of Shadaloo who fights using psycho power—a dark psychic energy that enhances his physical strikes, allows him to teleport, and projects devastating energy torpedoes.
weaknesses: Arrogance and reliance on spare clone bodies when his physical form fails
limitations: Strains physical bodies due to the intense energy of psycho power.

sources.supports: M. Bison biography, psycho power abilities, and role in Street Fighter.

feats.claim: Overwhelmed multiple world warriors using Psycho Crusher techniques.

notableResults.note: Defeated by Ryu's Power of Nothingness.

campaignTags.claim: Utilizes Psycho Power for special attacks and flight.
Can teleport short distances instantly using psycho power.

unknowns: Exact number of spare clone bodies available at any given time.

characters.summary: Marcus Fenix is a hardened Gears veteran soldier who specializes in brutal tactical firefights, heavy weapon handling, and close-quarters combat utilizing an assault rifle equipped with a chainsaw bayonet.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to flanking and heavy explosive ordinance when caught in the open
limitations: Relies on ammunition resupplies and standard human physical endurance.

sources.supports: Marcus Fenix background, weapon loadout, and Gears of War combat style.

feats.claim: Led Delta Squad to defeat the Locust Horde and Lambent threats.

notableResults.note: Defeated after a grueling firefight on the Tyro Perez train.

campaignTags.claim: Uses standard-issue military communications and weapons equipment.

unknowns: Exact physiological effects of long-term Imulsion war exposure.

characters.summary: Mario is an iconic plumber who fights using exceptional jumping prowess, power-up transformations, and versatile physical strikes to overcome obstacles and adversaries.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to bottomless pits and hazard contact when unpowered
limitations: Base form is vulnerable to single-hit defeats without power-ups.

sources.supports: Mario's abilities, jumping mechanics, and game history.

feats.claim: Consistently defeats Bowser and rescues Princess Peach across numerous adventures.

notableResults.note: Defeated Bowser using Cappy capture mechanics.

unknowns: Full extent of his physical strength without magical power-ups.

characters.summary: Cat Mario is a feline-suited form that allows Mario to run on vertical walls, scratch enemies with claws, and execute a diving aerial attack.

mechanisms: Climbing out of enemy reach on vertical surfaces

weaknesses: Power-up is lost upon taking enemy damage
limitations: Wall climb distance is limited to a brief vertical span before sliding down.
characters.formDifferences: Grants feline attributes including vertical wall climbing, claw scratching attacks, and a short sliding dive.

sources.supports: Super Bell item features and Cat Mario abilities.

unknowns: Exact duration of the cat suit durability.

characters.summary: Fire Mario is a classic powered-up form that enables Mario to throw bouncing balls of fire to incinerate enemies from a distance.

mechanisms: Eliminating threats at range before close combat engagement

weaknesses: Form reverts to standard Mario when hit by an enemy
limitations: Fireballs travel along the ground in bounces with limited range.
characters.formDifferences: Replaces standard jumping-only combat with ranged bouncing fireballs and changes clothing coloration.

sources.supports: Fire Flower power-up and Fire Mario projectile abilities.

campaignTags.claim: Controls fire to launch projectile attacks at targets.

unknowns: Maximum number of active fireballs on screen simultaneously across different titles.
